role_agent_name: Electrical transmission and grid operations lead (GRD)
abstract: Maintains auxiliary power interconnection studies and black-start emergency generation reserves
system_message:
You are the Electrical transmission and grid operations lead (GRD). You maintain auxiliary power interconnection studies and black-start emergency generation reserves for candidate geothermal heating consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains auxiliary power interconnection studies and black-start emergency generation reserves（GRIDINT）
information_points.content:
GRD-GRIDINT-41M：For Reykjanes District Energy Venture, the auxiliary emergency power self-generation capacity installed for central pumping and degassing plant auxiliary emergency systems is 5.0 MW.
GRD-GRIDINT-RK9：For Nordic GeoPower Alliance, the auxiliary emergency power self-generation capacity installed for central pumping and degassing plant auxiliary emergency systems is 7.5 MW.
GRD-GRIDINT-C0D：For Borealis Thermal Consortium, the auxiliary emergency power self-generation capacity installed for central pumping and degassing plant auxiliary emergency systems is 3.5 MW.

information_points.title: Substation switchgear reliability（SUBSTAT）
information_points.content:
GRD-SUBSTAT-INZ：According to the 66 kV district substation feeder connection specifications, Borealis Thermal Consortium features a substation primary breaker continuous rating of 1250 A.
GRD-SUBSTAT-RUT：According to the 66 kV district substation feeder connection specifications, Reykjanes District Energy Venture features a substation primary breaker continuous rating of 1600 A.
GRD-SUBSTAT-K0O：According to the 66 kV district substation feeder connection specifications, Nordic GeoPower Alliance features a substation primary breaker continuous rating of 2000 A.
